Skeleton draped in yellow, tattered robes. Master of Old Carcosa, the Dreamland city, and scribe of the Yellow Sign.

AC 16, HP 82, ATK 4 lash (near) +10 (2d8 + Wisdom bleed) and reveal visage, MV double near (fly), S +3, D +6, C +6, I +5, W +5, Ch +5, AL C, LV 17

Madness. Warps reality for all mortals within far. Each turn, WIS 18+ or 2d4 WIS damage. Insane at 0 WIS.

Pure Evil. Only damaged by magic sources. Dissolves if slain, reforms in Dreamlands.

Reveal Visage. Gaze at one creature within double near. CHA 18+ or lose 2d6 WIS permanently. Coma at 0 WIS.

Wisdom Bleed. 1d4 WIS damage each round. CON 12+, stabilize check, or healing to staunch.
